description.value: JD Farms Specialty Turkey is a family-run farm, deli market, and bistro in Langley's Fraser Valley, raising premium antibiotic-free turkeys for over 30 years. The on-farm Bistro serves house-made soups, sandwiches, wraps, hot entrees, and desserts, with a sunny patio for outdoor dining. Founded by Jack and Debbie Froese and now stewarded by their children, it offers a genuine farm-to-table experience in a part of BC popular with touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms JD Farms is an active farm store and bistro in Langley, BC at 24726 -52nd Ave, with phone 604-856-2431 and email turkey@jdfarms.ca — all absent from OSM tags. The bistro menu confirms vegetarian options (Vegetarian Sandwich listed) and a deli/market with ready-made meals confirming takeout. No bike-specific amenities (racks, charging, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'JD Farms' is a truncation of the full trading name 'JD Farms Specialty Turkey'; the listing may benefit from the fuller name.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags — all contact details sourced from website only.
Bike parking, washroom availability, and water refill are unconfirmed from website content; on-site verification recommended before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active farm bistro and market on a rural Fraser Valley road that is a natural touring-cyclist destination — real food, patio seating, and deli provisions. Core required criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are unconfirmed but not negated; a follow-up visit or phone call could verify.
